description: Seed row 1 catalog with a localeSupplier that negotiates the header 'und-Latn' and hands back a bare Locale — the winning locale, or the fallback locale when nothing matches, which is what happens here (und-Latn matches nothing, so the supplier returns fr). DefaultStrings then RE-DERIVES a match from that Locale, so the lossy collapse is observable: EXACT/fr instead of the NONE every other route in this row reports.
